title: Keep referenced and proposed owner inventories distinct in campaign accounting
body:
The private coordinator accounting helper for the complete unmatched-name campaign conflates referenced-owner and proposed-owner inventories while checking conflicts. This affects reporting, not chemical identity or the native case validator.

In `audit_campaign_accounting_v1.py`, the owner-conflict loop indexes both `defaultdict` objects for every path in their union. Those reads create empty entries in the other category. Later counts and serialized inventories therefore describe the union as both categories.

The frozen Worker 1 draft has 32 distinct referenced owner paths and 17 distinct proposed owner paths, with 8 shared paths (union 41). The current report incorrectly gives 41 for both counts. These are owner paths, not distinct chemical identities or accepted curation changes.

Independent diagnostic evidence under `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/campaign-accounting-counts-diagnostic-v1/`:

- `freeze-receipt.json` binds the examined helper and exact worker/report bytes. The report SHA256 is `9b93b627de4f2f7a721c9378e41de9c9b2199a79bfead614f3edc5255ace1870`.
- `probe_owner_counts_v1.py` and `probe-results.json` reproduce the bug on the frozen helper: reference-only reports an invented proposal; proposal-only reports an invented reference; disjoint categories are both inflated. Empty and shared-owner controls remain correct.

Fix the conflict-loop reads without mutating inventory membership, and add regression coverage for reference-only, proposal-only, disjoint, shared and empty categories. Preserve all case coverage, source/hash/path checks, conflict detection and the explicit distinction between structural accounting and scientific approval. Keep the original diagnostic and failing report.

The helper is currently private campaign working state. Publish the corrected helper, tests and review evidence with the campaign deliverable. This finding authorizes no maintained record change, mapping release, merge, or alteration of scientific holds. It is distinct from #1161, which concerns final path-role revalidation.

captured_comments.body:
The narrow private-helper fix is implemented and independently re-reviewed. The only implementation changes replace the two mutating dictionary lookups with `.get(path, [])`. Six added regressions distinguish referenced-only, proposed-only, disjoint, shared, empty and multiple-proposals-for-one-owner cases. All 77 combined tests pass; Ruff and Black pass.

The separate reviewer reproduced the original failures and replayed 12 original/fixed probes. Existing coverage, source/hash/path checks, conflict detection and the explicit scientific-approval boundary are unchanged. No new findings were reported.

- Fixed helper SHA256: `aa79c45a9e843e19207648b823a23838ccd6403d1796de853eed23c233c8f599`.
- Independent assessment: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/campaign-accounting-counts-independent-v1/review.json`, SHA256 `83ef9fef20718214c6813e6b4e54359f8972838f46d97c30ee2ca3c97cdd5e54`.
- Original diagnostic and failed report remain intact.

A fresh live-draft observation with the corrected helper reports 32 referenced owner paths and 17 proposed owner paths. It accounts structurally for Worker 1's 188 source cases; this is not scientific approval, publication or completion of the 1,879-case campaign. The remaining nine worker bundles are absent, not counted as success.

Keep this issue open pending publication of the corrected helper/tests and immutable evidence with the campaign deliverable. No maintained ingredient, mapping or workflow file changed for this fix.
